description: FRF-WP03 PRD intent-member payload contract. One stable atomic intent member of the PRD container (define-product-intent desk; plan 'Desk contracts/define-product-intent'). The member carries exactly one disposition of the closed four-value vocabulary (plan 'Target semantic trace grammar'); deferred and out_of_scope require owner and reason; direct_requirement requires a reason why no meaningful interaction or operational scenario exists. scopeClaimRefs cite the exact Discovery scope-claim text the member realizes; terminalClaimRefs cite the lifecycle terminal claims it owns. Payload contract only: no artifact type or storage owner is added.

disposition.description: Exactly one disposition per member (plan cr-04 law of the reverse graph).
Closed vocabulary: scenario_required | direct_requirement | deferred | out_of_scope.

reason.description: Required for deferred, out_of_scope and direct_requirement.

scopeClaimRefs.description: Exact Discovery scope-claim text references this member realizes (subset class of the accepted source claims).

sourceClaimRefs.description: Exact Discovery source claims the member derives from (min 1; reverse edge/0066 derived-from-exact-source-claims).

terminalClaimRefs.description: Lifecycle terminal claims owned by this member (reverse edge/0047: product terminal claims originate as PRD lifecycle-terminal-claim intent members).

title: FRF PRD intent member (frf-contracts.prd-intent-member.v1)
